notes.content: Since its launch, the game has received high praise. In order to allow more friends to play our game, the project team has decided to launch a 2-week spring promotion with an 8.8% discount

notes.title: Exclusive Memory Update for Three Days of Crisis
notes.content:
Hello dear players
Since its launch one and a half months ago, (Exclusive Memory of Three Day Crisis) has made the following updates based on feedback from players.
1. Players with perfect clearance saves can choose to skip the flying chess mode
2. Added the function of skipping random animations
3. Added clue collection prompt function
4. The screenshot of the clue becomes available for viewing mode
5. Increase the number of designated flying chess points
6. Adjusted some audio and visual unsynchronized videos
7. The game has decided to offer a discount promotion from November 13th to November 27th

notes.title: Exclusive Memory of Three Days of Crisis "is about to be released to everyone
notes.content:
Dear friends
The production team of "Exclusive Memory of Three Days of Crisis" would like to thank every friend who supports us and follows us!
Regardless of whether the theme and innovation can win the love of players and friends, "Exclusive Memory of Three Days of Crisis" will officially meet with everyone at 10:10am on September 30, 2024. Here, all members of the production team thank you for the improvement suggestions you have put forward for our product. Many friends have also asked us why we don't release a demo trial version because our work is about suspenseful love. In order to ensure everyone's gaming experience at that time, we have decided to let everyone open the blind box! Although there hasn't been a long interval between our approval and release, we still want to say that we've been waiting for it due to the market vacancy in September! As we approach its release, we are also extremely nervous. We hope that this work, which took 10 months to produce, can bring you a different experience!
